independent_method: Exact Fraction endpoint energies/exposures, separately implemented sum/sorted median/sample-variance tCI and log-ratio. No registered analyzer/helpers imported or executed; no native/process/app/input/video queries.
scope_limits: Named machine-wide GPU model energy and separately assigned CLPC CPU model counter, not app/physical/total-system energy. CPU ratio needs one common positive unit scale. Mixed sum direction blocked by opposite component directions.
Exact posted stream does not establish identical per-app visible work or every main frame. Pre/post output measurements are descriptive; different history areas and row heights remain.
Observer roles have different scopes and are included in the measured machine-wide envelope; do not add percentages, subtract CPU or convert it to watts.

Same-app main-PID ps TIME delta is over actual ~127s between two samples, quantized to centiseconds; excludes nonpersistent children and is not active60s CPU. Daemon CPU is full-run report-only, not app attribution or endpoint-window CPU.

Sixteen runs on one Mac/session; exploratory paired t intervals have8units and do not guarantee independent temporal errors. No physical-trackpad feel, stock-vs-PR749 efficacy or264repo performance claim.
